{{Top|legends=LiMerge Building/Legends}} {{Otheruses|Abandoned}} {{Update|[[The Sith Lord]], [[Inquisitor: Rise of the Red Blade]], [[Crimson Reign 2]], [[Star Wars: Complete Vehicles (2018)|Star Wars: Complete Vehicles]]}} {{Structure |image=[[File:InquisitoriusHeadquarters-2017DarthVader6.png]] |name=Inquisitorius Headquarters |constructed=By [[32 BBY]]Since "[[The Sith Lord]]" depicts the [[Coruscant]] tower as being in existence by the [[time]] of [[Star Wars: Episode I The Phantom Menace|''Star Wars'': Episode I ''The Phantom Menace'']], which takes place in [[32 BBY]] according to ''[[Star Wars: Galactic Atlas]]'', it can be deduced that the structure had been built by 32 [['ABY-BBY' dating system|BBY]]. |destroyed= |type= |location=[[The Works]], [[Coruscant]]{{Film|II}} |interest=*[[Ceremonial chamber]]{{SW|url=series/clone-wars/sacrifice-episode-guide|text="Sacrifice" Episode Guide | The Clone Wars}} *[[Coruscant tower secret hangar|Secret hangar]] |rebuilt= |builder= |height= |width= |affiliation=*[[LiMerge Power]][[Star Wars: Complete Vehicles (2018)|''Star Wars: Complete Vehicles'' (2018)]] *[[Sith]] Order *[[Galactic Empire]][[Darth Vader (2017) 6|''Darth Vader'' (2017) 6]] **[[Inquisitorius]] **[[Emperor's Royal Guard]][[Crimson Reign 2|''Crimson Reign'' 2]] }} {{Quote|Welcome home, Lord Tyranus.|Darth Sidious|audio=Sidious-WelcomeHome.flac|}} '''Inquisitorius Headquarters''' was a [[skyscraper]] maintained by the [[Dark Lord of the Sith]] [[Darth Sidious]]. It was located in [[the Works]], a district on the [[Core Worlds|Core World]] of [[Coruscant]], the [[capital]] of the [[Galactic Republic]] and later the [[Galactic Empire]]. Formerly known as the '''LiMerge Power building''', the abandoned tower served as [[Darth]] Sidious's secret hideout, with him using it to meet his [[Sith apprentice]] [[Dooku|Darth Tyranus]], publicly known as [[Count]] Dooku, after the [[First Battle of Geonosis|initiation]] of the [[Clone Wars]]. Later during the war, when they [[Force-sensitive|sensed]] that [[Grand Master]] [[Yoda]] of the [[Jedi Order]] was on [[Moraband]], the ancient [[Sith]] [[homeworld]], the two [[Sith Lord]]s conducted a [[Dark side of the Force|dark side]] [[Dark illusion|ritual]] in the tower. Although the ritual failed, Sidious and Dooku planned to use the ritual to tempt Yoda, breaking his will and further weakening the Jedi Order from within. The tower later served as the headquarters of the [[Inquisitorius]], a dark side organization of Imperial [[Jedi hunter]]s tasked with eliminating remaining Jedi after their [[Great Jedi Purge|destruction]], following the [[Proclamation of the New Order|rise]] of the Galactic Empire. After Sidious's newly appointed [[Sith apprentice]], [[Anakin Skywalker|Darth Vader]], familiarized himself with [[the Grand Inquisitor]] via Sidious, they traveled to the tower where Vader met the rest of the Inquisitorius. Following a [[Coruscant Incident|chase of two rogue Inquisitors]] which caused havoc on Coruscant, Sidious ordered that Vader move the Inquisitorius off-world to [[Fortress Inquisitorius]] on [[Nur]], giving him the planet [[Mustafar]] to make his [[Fortress Vader|personal stronghold]]. After the tower was vacated by the Inquisitorius, it was used as the living quarters for the [[Emperor's Royal Guard]]. Due to the need for the carefully vetted bodyguards to be completely isolated, they only left the tower to be [[transport]]ed directly to the [[Imperial Palace]] for their shift, returning to the building for breakfast in the morning. During its use by the Royal Guard, the tower was infiltrated by an [[assassin droid]] programmed by [[Ochi]] to [[poison]] the food of the Guards and send a message to Palpatine on behalf of the [[Crimson Dawn]]. ==Design== [[File:InquisitoriusConferenceRoom-2017DarthVader7.png|thumb|left|300px|The Grand Inquisitor and Darth Vader converse in the tower's conference room.]] What was later known as the [[Inquisitorius]] Headquarters during the [[Imperial Era]][[Darth Vader (2017) 20|''Darth Vader'' (2017) 20]] was originally the [[LiMerge Power]] building.[[Star Wars: Complete Vehicles (2018)|''Star Wars: Complete Vehicles'' (2018)]] The skyscraper was located in [[the Works]], an industrial district located on the [[planet]] [[Coruscant]], [[capital]] of the [[Galactic Republic]]. The base of the building was composed of three large fins that met at the mid-section of the structure, and from one of which extended a smaller secondary structure that, during the Clone Wars, was connected to the main building by several derelict walkways.{{TCW|Sacrifice (episode)}} A large, central, cylindrical pillar with a coned head protruded from the mid-section. Also in the mid-section was a [[Coruscant tower secret hangar|secret hangar]] with multiple hatches that opened upwards, enabling [[Starship|ships]] as large as a [[Punworcca 116-class interstellar sloop|''Punworcca 116''-class interstellar sloop]] to enter and exit. Upon entering the [[hangar]], the [[ceremonial chamber]] was to the left, which was donned with statues. The exterior of the tower was in a neglectful state by the time of the Clone Wars, with areas of the structure being worn down and damaged. By the early [[Standard day|days]] of the [[Galactic Empire]], the tower had a large central chamber, a conference room,[[Darth Vader (2017) 7|''Darth Vader'' (2017) 7]] and a leisure area. During this time, the exterior had been upgraded and repaired. The secondary structure was transformed into a landing platform, and the multiple walkways were replaced by a singular pathway. In the leisure area, the Inquisitors could drink [[alcohol]]ic beverages and sit down at one of the tables.[[Darth Vader (2017) 19|''Darth Vader'' (2017) 19]] The leisure area had several corridors, including one that led to a walkway outside the building to a small degraded platform. ==History== ===Before the Clone Wars=== {{Quote|I'm afraid-"''
''"I know you are."''
''"I'm afraid it is too late.|Count Dooku and Yaddle shortly before dueling|{{TOTJ|The Sith Lord}}}} In [[32 BBY]],"[[The Sith Lord]]" takes place concurrently to [[Star Wars: Episode I The Phantom Menace|''Star Wars'': Episode I ''The Phantom Menace'']], which takes place in [[32 BBY]] according to ''[[Star Wars: Galactic Atlas]]''. after [[Qui-Gon Jinn]]'s death at the hands of [[Maul|Darth Maul]] on [[Naboo]], [[Count of Serenno|Count]] [[Dooku]] traveled to the hidden lair. Before leaving the [[Imperial Palace|Jedi Temple]], he spoke with [[Yaddle]], a member of the [[Jedi High Council]]. The Jedi councillor became suspicious of Dooku when the latter said he would not attend the funeral of his former Padawan and close friend on Naboo. Shortly thereafter, the [[Serennian]] [[Count]] left the Temple and headed to The Works. Unbeknownst to him, he was tailed by the [[Jedi Master]]. When reaching the building, the Jedi found Dooku plotting with the [[Dark Lord of the Sith|Sith Lord]] [[Darth Sidious]] in a building. Yaddle revealed herself, but when Dooku's stance was made clear, she was force to [[Duel in the Works|engage]] in a [[lightsaber duel]] with him. Dooku defeated his former ally, executing her after coldly sneering that he would give her peace. This act pleased Sidious, as it brought the former Jedi closer to the [[Dark side of the Force|dark side]]. ===The Clone Wars=== ====Bringing good news==== {{Quote|I have good news for you, my lord. The war has begun."''
''"Excellent. Everything is going as planned.|Darth Tyranus and Darth Sidious|audio=TheWarHasBegun-AOTC.flac|}} [[File:Sith_lair_The_Works.png|thumb|right|300px|Darth Tyranus arrived at the tower at the beginning of the Clone Wars.]] Following the [[First Battle of Geonosis|opening battle]] of the [[Clone Wars]] and a [[lightsaber duel]] against the [[Jedi]] in [[22 BBY]],''[[Star Wars: Galactic Atlas]]'' Count Dooku, by this point [[Head of State|leader]] of the [[Confederacy of Independent Systems]] and secretly the Sith Lord [[Darth]] Tyranus, traveled in his [[Count Dooku's solar sailer|personal]] [[solar sailer]] to the tower{{SW|url=series/clone-wars/sacrifice-concept-art-gallery|text="Sacrifice" Concept Art Gallery}} {{C|Slide 5}} in the Works district on Coruscant to meet with his [[Sith Master]], which served as a secret retreat and storage for [[Sith artifact]]s.[[Star Wars: Complete Locations (2016)|''Star Wars: Complete Locations'']] Once Dooku had arrived at the tower's hangar, he was greeted by his [[Sith]] Master, Darth Sidious, and informed him that the war between the Galactic Republic and the Confederacy had begun. Sidious was pleased at the news, as he had achieved another milestone in his plan to [[Great Jedi Purge|destroy]] the [[Jedi Order]] and rule the galaxy,{{Databank|emperor-palpatine-darth-sidious|Emperor Palpatine/Darth Sidious}} and stated that everything was going according to plan. ====Breaking the Jedi Order==== =====Late Clone Wars===== {{Quote|Sir, you have been ordered to go to Coruscant immediately.''"
"''Tell Lord Sidious I am on my way.|Kraken to Darth Tyranus|audio=Kraken_and_Dooku.flac|}} In [[19 BBY]],''[[Star Wars: Galactic Atlas]]'' dates [[Ahsoka Tano]]'s departure from the [[Jedi Order]], which was depicted in the ''[[Star Wars: The Clone Wars]]'' episode "[[The Wrong Jedi]]," to [[19 BBY]]. ''Star Wars: Galactic Atlas'' places the [[Battle of Coruscant]] in [[Galactic standard calendar|19 BBY]] as well. According to {{SW|url=news/star-wars-the-clone-wars-chronological-episodeorder|text=''Star Wars: The Clone Wars'' Chronological Episode Order}}, "[[Orders (episode)|Orders]]," where the [[mission to Level 1325]] is depicted, takes place after "The Wrong Jedi" and before [[Star Wars: Episode III Revenge of the Sith|''Star Wars'': Episode III ''Revenge of the Sith'']], where the Battle of [[Coruscant]] takes place. Therefore, the mission to [[Level 1325]] must take place in 19 BBY. the [[Grand Republic Medical Facility]] was temporarily shut down to increase security after a [[mission to Level 1325]] to capture rogue [[clone trooper]] [[Fives|CT-5555]] after he allegedly attacked [[Supreme Chancellor]] Palpatine, secretly Sidious. During the lockdown, Sidious transported his collection of Sith artifacts from the abandoned tower to the medical facility, due to concerns that the Jedi may discover the tower. Following the [[Mission to Oba Diah (Clone Wars)|mission]] to [[Oba Diah]],{{TCW|Voices}} [[Grand Master]] Yoda had embarked on a [[mission to Moraband]] in order to uncover the secrets of [[Force spirit|preserving]] [[Sentience|one's consciousness]] after [[death]] and attempt to uncover the identity of the [[Sith Lord]] who had been manipulating the Jedi and had created the [[Grand Army of the Republic|clone army]] for them.{{TCW|The Lost One}} [[File:TCW_Tower_Ceremonial_chamber.png|thumb|left|300px|Darth Sidious and Darth Tyranus prepare to perform a ritual in the ceremonial chamber of the tower.]] The quest led Yoda to [[Moraband]], the ancient [[homeworld]] of the [[Sith]].{{TCW|Destiny (The Clone Wars)}} Apparitions of [[Sith Warrior (Moraband)|Sith Warriors]] conjured by the [[Force Priestesses]]{{Databank|moraband|Moraband}} alerted Sidious and Dooku of Yoda's presence on Moraband, and Dooku was informed by his [[ST-series military strategic analysis and tactics droid|super tactical droid]], [[Commander]] [[Kraken]], that his master was ordering him to Coruscant and meet with him. After Dooku arrived from his [[Dooku's Providence-class carrier/destroyer|flagship]], Sidious greeted Dooku and led him to the tower's ceremonial chamber which was lined with statues positioned in a circle with a sacrificial altar basin at its center. Sidious then began a [[Dark illusion|ritual]], using Dooku's [[blood]] and [[Force-bond]] to connect with his former Jedi Master, Yoda, while also using [[Force lightning]] and chanting [[Balc]], a Sith [[language]]. =====The vision===== {{Quote|There is no question. The ship was carrying Count Dooku. We've scanned the area, and he is meeting with someone inside the building.|Captain Rex, to Anakin Skywalker in the vision|}} By utilizing the ritual, Sidious was able exploit [[the Force]]-bond to reach through ripples through the Force to create [[Force Illusion]]s on Moraband, hoping to break Yoda's will and tear the Jedi Order from within. In the following [[Force vision|illusions]], Yoda saw himself back on Coruscant in the Works onboard a [[Low Altitude Assault Transport/infantry|LAAT/i gunship]] with fellow [[Jedi Knight]] Anakin Skywalker, [[Clone Captain]] [[Rex|CT-7567]], and a [[squad]] of [[Cloning|clone]] [[trooper]]s who were tasked with a mission to the tower after detecting a rogue shuttle that infiltrated Coruscant's security grid, believing that Dooku was onboard. Initially confused, Yoda nevertheless ordered the mission to continue. Yoda believed that they were on the verge of discovering the mystery of the Sith, and that the Sith must not be able to escape, executing them if necessary. [[File:Dark_side_ritual.png|thumb|right|300px|Sidious and Tyranus conduct the ritual.]] After the LAAT/i landed in the hangar of the abandoned tower, Yoda, Skywalker, Rex, and the clones discovered Sidious and Dooku in the ceremonial chamber. Dooku attacked the group with Force lightning, killing Rex and the clone troopers. Skywalker [[Lightsaber combat|engaged]] Dooku in a [[lightsaber]] duel and was able to kill the Sith Lord, but not before Yoda exclaimed to Skywalker not to. Regardless, Yoda chased Darth Sidious to the outside of the tower, with Skywalker arriving outside shortly after. After dueling with Sidious, Skywalker was defeated and rendered unconscious. Sidious continued fighting Yoda, attempting to break Yoda's will by forcing him to choose between saving Skywalker, or learning Sidious's true identity and stopping all he would do. Yoda chose the former, allowing himself to be struck by Force lightning but saving Skywalker. Sidious ended the ritual and thus eliminating the spiritual plane they were on, having failed to break Yoda's will. Defeated, Sidious stated that they would need more [[time]] to defeat the Jedi, while Yoda gained a new perspective about the Force that the Sith would not be able to foresee. ===Reign of the Empire=== ====Use by the Inquisitorius==== {{Quote|Come with me.|Darth Sidious to Lord Vader|}} In 19 BBY, after the [[Proclamation of the New Order|rise]] of the Galactic Empire and the [[Order 66|destruction]] of the Jedi Order, Darth Sidious, now the [[Galactic Emperor]] of the newly transformed [[Galactic Empire]],{{Film|III}} founded the [[Inquisitorius]], a [[Dark side of the Force|dark side]] organization tasked with eliminating any remaining Jedi. After the leader of the Inquisitorius, [[the Grand Inquisitor]], briefly [[Duel in the former Jedi Temple|dueled]] Sidious's new Sith apprentice, Darth Vader, Sidious acquainted them and informed Vader of the Inquisitorius, which were located in the tower, dubbed the Inquisitorius Headquarters. [[File:WorksTower-2017DarthVader6.png|thumb|left|250px|Darth Sidious converses with Darth Vader on the tower's platform.]] The tower had been refurbished with a new landing platform, a large chamber, a conference room, and was guarded by the [[Emperor's Royal Guard]]. There, as the Inquisitors trained with each other in the main chamber, Lord Vader was given command of the Inquisitorius and was given the task of training them. After some time training with the inquisitors, Vader and the [[Grand Inquisitor]] conversed in a conference room, reviewing a list of possible Jedi survivors. They were tasked with [[Hunt for Jocasta Nu|tracking down]] [[Chief Librarian]] [[Jocasta Nu]], who was considered by Sidious to be a high priority target. =====Hunting rogue Inquisitors===== ======After hunting Eeth Koth====== {{Quote|Lord Vader…what is this? Can the Inquisitors and I assist in any way?''"
"''No, Grand Inquisitor. No need.|The Grand Inquisitor and Darth Vader, after exposing the rogue Inquisitors|}} Years after Order 66, in the aftermath of a [[Hunt for Eeth Koth|mission]] to hunt down former Jedi Master [[Eeth Koth]], Darth Vader and his team of Inquisitors consisting of [[Fifth Brother]], [[Thirteenth Sister]], and [[Tualon Yaluna]],''[[Inquisitor: Rise of the Red Blade]]'' arrived in their [[Zeta-class shuttle|''Zeta''-class shuttle]] and touched down on the tower's landing platform. They were greeted by the Grand Inquisitor, along with two [[Kallidahin]] [[Nursemaids|servants]], who were given Koth's captured [[Eeth Koth's daughter|newborn]]. Vader and the Grand Inquisitor then headed to the conference room, and began conversing on Jedi survivors of the purge as they looked at a list of survivors, as well as the status of [[Project Harvester]]. During the time after their arrival from the [[Unidentified planet (Eeth Koth)|planet]] they had killed Koth on, several of the Inquisitors, including [[Eighth Brother]], [[Seventh Sister]], the Grand Inquisitor, the Inquisitors who accompanied Vader to eliminate Koth, and the [[Second Sister]] were present at the tower's leisure room, where Akaris and Tualon were at a table drinking [[dust juice]] and talking about recent experiences, although Vader confronted the two and ignited [[Darth Vader's lightsaber|his lightsaber]]. ======Rogue Inquisitors====== {{Quote|I will move the Inquisitors to a new base, off-planet. This will not happen again.|Sidious, to Vader after the chase|}} [[File:VaderVsInquisitors-2017DarthVader20.jpg|thumb|right|225px|Lord Vader faces the two Rogue Inquisitors in the tower.]] With Vader standing before them, the two Inquisitors were stunned and the other Inquisitors were confused to reach for his lightsaber. As Vader brought down his lightsaber on Akaris, it was blocked by Tualon and after a brief scuffle, the two Inquisitors [[Coruscant Incident|escaped]] through a corridor that led to an outside walkway and platform that had not been renovated as it was in a deteriorated state, and fled to the [[Imperial City|city]], although Vader eventually managed to [[Death|kill]] them. After the chase, Sidious believed that the Inquisitorius should be moved off-world, and Vader asked his master Sidious to give him the planet [[Mustafar]], the location of Vader's [[Duel on Mustafar|greatest defeat]],{{Databank|darth-vader|Darth Vader}} to become the location of his [[Fortress Vader|personal castle]], to which Sidious agreed. As such, the Inquisitors were assigned a new headquarters, the [[Fortress Inquisitorius]]''[[Star Wars Jedi: Fallen Order]]'' on the [[water]] [[moon]] [[Nur]] near Mustafar.''[[The Art of Star Wars Jedi: Fallen Order]]'' Having been constructed early in the Imperial Era, the Fortress Inquisitorius had already existed as a major base of operations{{TOTE|Devoted}} while the LiMerge Building was used as headquarters. ====Royal Guard base==== {{Quote|These folks are ''precise''. I know exactly where they'll be and when. ''[..]'' They'll be having their breakfast any time now.|Ochi describes the Guard's schedule to ASN-909|}} [[File:RoyalGuardAssassination-CrimsonReign2.png|left|thumb|290x290px|Royal Guards inside their living quarters]] After the Inquisitorius left LiMerge for the Fortress on Nur, the skyscraper was repurposed as the living quarters for the [[Emperor's Royal Guard]] due to the need to keep them isolated from the Imperial population for safety reasons as well as due to them being privy to Palpatine's deepest secrets, The Guards followed a regular schedule, having breakfast at the tower every morning and then putting on their uniforms and departing for the [[Imperial Palace]] via [[shuttle]]. In [[3 ABY]],The assassination is mentioned as being recent in ''[[Star Wars Outlaws]]'', which is set in [[3 ABY]] per the reasoning [[Template:OutlawsDate|here]]. [[assassin]] [[Ochi]], working for [[Qi'ra]] and the [[Crimson Dawn]], infiltrated the tower using [[ASN-909]], an [[ASN courier droid]] modified as an [[assassin droid]] and had it [[poison]] their food with [[Ziroxin-12]] timed to kill them as Palpatine would be arriving before them. Royal Guard [[Major]] [[Erstin Deez]] had skipped breakfast to go directly to work, prompting Ochi to shoot him with his [[sniper rifle]] coated with [[yurfloo]] poison instead. Not knowing that they had been attacked, the Guards donned their uniforms and headed to the Palace, dropping dead as soon as Palpatine and [[Mas Amedda]] entered the chamber. ==Behind the scenes== [[File:Sidious_Lair_concept_art_TAoEII.png|thumb|left|300px|Concept art of the tower in The Works.]] Named the Inquisitorius Headquarters in the [[2018]] [[canon]] comic by [[Charles Soule]], [[Darth Vader (2017) 20|''Darth Vader'' (2017) 20]], the tower was created for the [[2002]] [[prequel trilogy]] film [[Star Wars: Episode II Attack of the Clones|''Star Wars'': Episode II ''Attack of the Clones'']]. The tower was described as the "'''Coruscant tower'''" in a caption via the [[StarWars.com]] episode guide for "[[Sacrifice (episode)|Sacrifice]]," the final episode of the animated television series ''[[Star Wars: The Clone Wars]]'', released in [[2014]].{{SW|url=news/star-wars-the-clone-wars-the-lost-missions-now-on-netflix|text=Star Wars: The Clone Wars – The Lost Missions Now on Netflix|nolive=1}} The tower was originally introduced in the [[Star Wars Legends|''Star Wars'' Legends]] continuity through the [[Star Wars: Episode II Attack of the Clones (novelization)|novelization]] of ''Attack of the Clones'',[[Star Wars: Episode II Attack of the Clones (novelization)|''Star Wars'': Episode II ''Attack of the Clones'' novelization]] released prior to the film in 2002.{{SWArchive|url=episode-ii/release/publish/news20020205.html|text=Book Preview: The Episode II Novel}} In [[2012]], it was identified as the "[[Inquisitorius Headquarters/Legends|LiMerge Building]]" by the Legends novel [[Darth Plagueis (novel)|''Darth Plagueis'']].[[Darth Plagueis (novel)|''Darth Plagueis'']] It was canonically identified with such name in the [[2018]] reference book ''[[Star Wars: Complete Vehicles (2018)|Star Wars: Complete Vehicles]]''. The LiMerge Building was first depicted as the headquarters for the Inquisitorius in Soule's [[2017]] ''[[Star Wars: Darth Vader (2017)|Star Wars: Darth Vader]]'' comic series. The building made its debut in that capacity in [[Darth Vader (2017) 6|''Darth Vader'' issue 6]] before being outright identified as their headquarters in issue 20. The novel ''[[Ahsoka (novel)|Ahsoka]]'' featured the Inquisitor known as the Sixth Brother contact his personal headquarters, but it is unclear if that refers to[[Ahsoka (novel)|''Ahsoka'']] the former Li-Merge Building or the [[Fortress Inquisitorius]] building, which also existed during that time. ==Appearances== *[[Jedi Knights 5|''Jedi Knights'' 5]] {{C|Appears in flashforward(s)}}
